title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Albert Einstein?
description:
A British prime minister, Winston Churchill and Charlie Chaplin connect Adolf Hitler to Albert Einstein.

Adolf Hitler → David Lloyd George → Winston Churchill → Charlie Chaplin → Albert Einstein

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → David Lloyd George: In 1936, Britain's old wartime prime minister, David Lloyd George, visited Hitler at his mountain home.
   Photo by US National Archives (NARA), via US Holocaust Memorial Museum, Public domain: https://collections.ushmm.org/search/catalog/pa1051321
2. David Lloyd George → Winston Churchill: In 1907, Lloyd George and a young Winston Churchill were so close they were nicknamed the Terrible Twins.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:ChurchillGeorge0001.jpg
3. Winston Churchill → Charlie Chaplin: In 1929, Churchill dropped by Hollywood to watch Charlie Chaplin film City Lights.
   Photo by T. Garrett (+1935\), Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:ChurchillChaplin0001.jpg
4. Charlie Chaplin → Albert Einstein: In 1931, Albert Einstein joined him for its opening night.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Albert_Einstein_and_Charlie_Chaplin_City_Lights_premiere_1931.jpg

Research notes: Einstein did visit Churchill at Chartwell in 1933, but no photo of the two together is known, so the route runs through Chaplin, who met both men.

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#adolfhitler #alberteinstein #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
